description: llama.cpp fork serving natlang's native models: native state spans (consume), native state production (producer adapter and capture) and the native-state protocol (/v1/neuralese/info, /v1/neuralese/native-states), decision readout (/v1/natlang/score), guided generation (guidance) and per-sequence LoRA in llama-server; parity dumps in tools/neuralese. The pinned commit is the default branch neuralese merged with upstream 0893ec98f (NATLANG_FORK.md there), including backend-sampling RL capture and guidance bans; it is also natlang's managed runtime release natlang-b12067. A separate git checkout, not vendored; vendor/llama.cpp is a converter snapshot of the pinned commit. The browser's wllama is built from this branch.

converter_snapshot.contents: git archive of the pinned commit: convert_hf_to_gguf.py convert_lora_to_gguf.py conversion gguf-py requirements

build_cpu: cmake -S . -B build-cpu && cmake --build build-cpu --target llama-server llama-state-span-dump llama-logits-dump -j16
build_cuda: cmake -S . -B build-cuda -DGGML_CUDA=ON && cmake --build build-cuda --target llama-server llama-state-span-dump -j16
parity: scripts/neuralese_data/check_llama_producer_parity.py (native state production against the native engine)
scripts/neuralese_data/check_tuned_lora_llama_parity.py (tuned LoRA against the native adapted model)
scripts/neuralese_data/check_llama_native_state_protocol.py (llama-server native-state protocol: store, consumption receipts, production, exact reference encoding)

verification.converter: LFM3-1.7B base converted to BF16 GGUF by the 85a2e716 and a6401bbd converters: all 287 tensors and every metadata field identical
verification.serving: 61704e99 (a6401bbd minus backend-sampling capture, CI and reasoning streaming): greedy completions bit-identical to b89457f32 on CPU and CUDA; native-state protocol and producer parity on LFM3 step142
